{"answer":"Based on my search of the context filesystem, I can provide you with the answer:

**The final decision is to REMOVE the `group.protocol` client configuration entirely in AK 6.0, not keep it restricted to a single allowed value.**

This is documented in the following sources:

1. **Primary Decision Statement** - In the email from Lianet Magrans on February 14-16, 2026 (events/2026/02/16/mail-2b8888b66b964eada5234616-b9c0301d.md):
   > "I clarified in the KIP around the group.protocol config. The intention is indeed to deprecate the public-facing group.protocol config in 5.0 and remove in 6.0."

2. **Earlier Alignment** - On January 28, 2026 (events/2026/02/13/mail-b96c0c41bad0fc9745839b89-22fe5f2c.md), Lianet stated:
   > "Also updated the content around the group.protocol property, going back to the initial proposal of removing it as unneeded after the transition."

While Andrew Schofield had suggested an alternative approach on January 28, 2026 (events/2026/01/28/mail-263b0239b98e36fe0c99fba8-9c9ec008.md) to "leave the config but only permit the value 'consumer'," the final KIP-1274 decision adopted the approach to deprecate and fully remove the configuration in AK 6.0 as unneeded after the transition to the new consumer protocol is complete.","error":null,"files":["store","events/2026/02/24/jira-13588764-comment-18060517-3ecbd7d4.md","events/2026/02/24/jira-13588764-comment-18060593-92d25068.md","events/2026/02/24/jira-13588764-comment-18060653-6021bdf3.md","events/2026/02/24/jira-13588764-change-22949421-0-02d920a0.md","events/2026/02/24/jira-13588764-change-22949979-0-ac25a1a4.md","events/2026/02/23/mail-250325edcc057c80123ff462-c8a9939c.md","events/2026/02/23/mail-47eb079b4b68cc79bfdc73e1-2378b0e1.md","events/2026/02/23/mail-6af1973be65b5632ccc3404d-a75c98ed.md","events/2026/02/16/mail-2b8888b66b964eada5234616-b9c0301d.md","events/2026/02/20/mail-636f39043956784fc7b822fb-4fda4104.md","events/2026/02/20/mail-7f9935b74d780f9d89947fe1-7b70fd8c.md","events/2026/02/22/mail-6ea3402c8bc00ae4fb37dcf5-d5ef6d28.md","events/2026/02/22/mail-c4bfde361f38ca346dffd233-ed6480b7.md","events/2026/01/28/mail-263b0239b98e36fe0c99fba8-9c9ec008.md","events/2026/02/25/mail-07b70ae8336d39b53176a355-feacf866.md","events/2026/02/25/mail-43a69f4de879138fe6b8137e-af61aec4.md","events/2026/02/13/mail-5371af1bfff5b5ae3ade8e7e-368d6f39.md","events/2026/02/13/mail-8026034d18ce85d4e38a67b5-89a6388d.md","events/2026/02/13/mail-9e9873790f02dfa33f926129-37adfb56.md","events/2026/02/13/mail-b96c0c41bad0fc9745839b89-22fe5f2c.md"],"seconds":86.32,"truncated":false,"turns":2,"usage":{"cache_read_tokens":1060835,"cache_write_tokens":79956,"cost_usd":0.29516449999999994,"input_tokens":194,"output_tokens":5795}}
